segments.text: A pandemic with relatively low mortality is not managed by counting the cases.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: It's managed by preventing hospitalization and mortality.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: And so this slide that you see now shows the breakdown, the distribution of mortality through September of last year.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: And you can see that there are almost no bars in the youngest age groups, and that's because there is almost no mortality.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: And the mortality that exists in those age groups is due to chronic conditions such as obesity, diabetes, chronic heart disease, chronic kidney disease, immunocompromised.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: Almost entirely in those age groups, and even in the older age groups,
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: the mortality is among people who have multiple chronic conditions.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: But the point of this is that when you have such low or non-existent mortality in these low age groups,
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: the potential serious adverse effects of the vaccine will surmount the non-existent mortality of these age groups.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: And therefore, what we've been told that everybody has to be vaccinated, that all these approvals for the vaccines that have pushed their way down into the youngest age groups had no reason to be there in the first place because there was no mortality that they were trying to prevent.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: We already know that the vaccines don't prevent spread as the CDC said on August 11th.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: So the only point of them is for personal protection as treatment if one wants to choose that.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: And yet there's no reason to choose that when the mortality from the infection is orders of magnitude less than it would be from the vaccine.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
